items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: And another time we was on a job, we went, I don't know who was playing, but I think Joe Rene was on that job. Bill Matthews.

ctx.x: When I look at it, it was $3.75 instead of $4. That quarter meant a lot. My man, that's a fella who booked us. I said, man, if I'm a catcher, I'll break your name. Don't call me to book. That's for that quarter. And another time we was on a job, we went, I don't know who was playing, but I think Joe Rene was on that job. Bill Matthews. We went down the valley or a bureau somewhere down the line. Mm-hmm. Off the river. Those people had a big table spread out with food. But me, I'm a young fella with the band. All…
